runs.name: TransAlta Corporation; NYSE TAC, TSX TA, SEC CIK 0001144800, Calgary, 40-F filer in Canadian dollars under IFRS; one of Canada's largest publicly traded power generators, six segments (Hydro, Wind and Solar, Gas, Energy Transition, Energy Marketing, Corporate), 58 per cent of gross installed capacity in Alberta sold merchant into the Alberta pool; Heartland Generation bought 2024-12-04; 18,230,000 shares sold at C$19.20 on 2026-06-09 to fund two Colorado gas peakers bought for about US$1.0 billion, closed 2026-10-22 with 49 per cent of the Oklahoma wind sold to Ares for US$305 million the same day; the 40-F names no rival, Vistra and NRG chosen as a CONVENTION of the run, Capital Power flagged as not an SEC filer
runs.entry: Price **C$17.14** (TSX close 2026-10-23; US$12.22 NYSE the same day; aggregator, flagged). Shares **316.0 million** at 2026-06-30 (interim statements, 6-K 0001144800-26-000040; the 40-F cover's 296,717,495 through `Screens/cover_shares.py` plus the June bought deal and share plans; over-allotment not shown exercised); market cap C$5,416 million. Sovereign **4.12%**, Government of Canada long-term benchmark, Bank of Canada series BD.CDN.LONG.DQ.YLD, 2026-10-23 (no CAD row in the protocol's table). Read from the 40-F for FY2025 (0001144800-26-000015: annual information form, MD&A, IFRS statements), the 40-Fs for FY2024, FY2023, FY2021, FY2019 and FY2017, the 2026 circular (0001144800-26-000019), the 6-Ks of 2026-06-09, 2026-07-31 and 2026-10-22; `tools/run.py` failed on this IFRS filer, every figure from the filed statements. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual information form and the MD&A's risk section, six lines stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: a power seller whose economics can be read from its figures. **Q2 OUT**: the deciding part, Gas (38% of 2021 to 2025 segment adjusted EBITDA; about one point ahead of Hydro after an estimated depreciation, a CONVENTION of the run, segment depreciation filed for 2024 and 2025 only), mostly coal units of 1975 to 1990 converted to gas, a price-taker in the Alberta pool, the filer's own words that older units "may, over time, be unable to compete" with newer turbines, Sundance 6 and Sheerness 1 mothballed; over the full Alberta price cycle 2016 to 2025 (pool price C$18 to C$162 to C$44) operating income about 3.2% a year on assets, earnings to common summed C$-546 million, equity C$4.66 to 1.47 billion, deficit deeper by C$1.8 billion with borrowings flat near C$3.6 billion; Vistra about 3.7% and NRG about 5.7% on the same measure over the same span. Q3 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: sustaining capital averaging C$174 million a year against depreciation of C$591 million; adjusted EBITDA and FCF featured, guided and paid on, 2025 below the outlook range; impairments in eight of ten years; Market Surveillance Administrator penalties of C$33 million for Brazeau spinning-reserve offers (self-reported, 2021 to 2022) and MSA payments of C$31 million (2015) and C$25 million (2016), integrity recorded, not judged; buybacks at no stated price and shares issued at C$19.20; Brookfield's C$750 million exchangeable into up to 49% of the Alberta hydro assets through 2028; reclamation provisions C$891 million; BB+. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE, beneath the stop, all-equity central (merchant generation, not a regulated utility): cycle base 2016 to 2025 (specific (a), the literal window 2021 to 2025 beside), the no-growth case alone (one cycle, sales flat at about C$2.4 billion), sustaining capital as the maintenance guess (specific (e)); preferred shares and the exchangeable counted in net debt (C$5,852 million), a CONVENTION of the run. Owner cash C$522 million a year all-equity, C$300 million equity-only, C$225 million after all spending; value range **C$21.56** a share, the no-growth case alone, all-equity (C$19.99 equity-only; all spending C$-1.25; literal window C$26.41); 4.6% at the price all-equity, 4.7% equity-only, no case earns the floor, so Q7 would also close OUT; fair price **not positive all-equity (C$-2.01), C$6.43 equity-only**. Commits 7527f735 (template), eb2c9508 (Step 0 and Q1), 510ec446 (Q2), fea8595e (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Contamination declared: a file-name filter on `Test Runs/` before the template copy printed three other companies' file names, none about this company, none opened; session-start commit subjects (another company's run) and the memory index; none used. Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` 36 ids, 18 fragments, no slip, no E-id; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 36 ids all in the ledger, no E-id, 18 adjacent quoted fragments, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) the parts rule has no measure for a filer without segment operating profit and no rule for a near tie (Gas and Hydro about one point apart after estimated depreciation, with opposite castles; Hydro deciding would carry the file to Q3); (2) rivals when the filing names none and the natural peer files only on SEDAR+; (3) specific (a) with one full cycle on the record, and its fit with (b); (4) specific (e) gives no test of a maintenance guess against depreciation (sustaining capital about 30% of depreciation in a shrinking fleet; the depreciation variant C$-10.50); (5) net debt's definition does not name preferred shares or exchangeable securities; (6) a partial sale closed after the window is not covered by the convention for later deals; (7) no CAD row in the protocol's sovereign table. Could not get: segment depreciation before 2024, unit heat rates, the underlying 2015 to 2016 MSA matter. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (TransAlta, TAC; Canadian power generator, 40-F filer in C$, 58% of capacity merchant in Alberta; Q1 IN; Q2 OUT on the deciding part, Gas, old converted coal units the filer says may not compete with newer turbines, a price-taker in the Alberta pool; over the full price cycle 2016 to 2025 operating income about 3.2% a year on assets, earnings to common C$-546 million, equity C$4.66 to 1.47 billion, against Vistra 3.7% and NRG 5.7%; Gas leads Hydro by about one point after estimated depreciation, a CONVENTION of the run; integrity facts recorded, not judged: MSA penalties C$33 million (Brazeau, self-reported) and C$31 and C$25 million in 2015 and 2016; computation only: value C$21.56 the no-growth case alone all-equity vs C$17.14, 4.6% at the price, fair not positive all-equity (C$-2.01), C$6.43 equity-only; CAD sovereign 4.12% from the Bank of Canada; no citation slip; not held; not armed; framework gaps for the operator: the parts rule without segment operating profit and a near tie, rivals when the natural peer is SEDAR+ only, specific (a) with one cycle, no test of a maintenance guess against depreciation, preferred and exchangeable securities in net debt, a partial sale after the window, no CAD sovereign row; the analyst declared a Test Runs file-name filter that showed three other companies' names, commit subjects and memory lines, none used)
